# ConfigurAI

> ConfigurAI is a London AI training and implementation consultancy for finance teams, accountancy firms and small businesses, founded by Orgesa Meli after 17 years in corporate finance and banking.

ConfigurAI trains finance teams and accountancy firms to use AI in their own files and accounting systems, and runs AI audits for small businesses. Finance training is delivered in your office in London and the South East, or online.

## Products

- [AI training for finance teams](https://configurai.com/ai-for-finance-teams): AI training and implementation for finance teams and accountancy firms, in your office in London and the South East or online, as 2 hours of training, a half day or a full day. The half day includes a pre-session call, a written guide within 3 working days, 30 days of quick questions by phone or email, and follow-up calls to check how you are getting on. Prices on enquiry. Built on Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, Zoho Books, FreeAgent, Sage Intacct, Business Central and NetSuite.
- [AI for small businesses](https://configurai.com/ai-for-small-businesses): Start with an AI audit: a 30 to 45 minute Zoom interview, a 7 to 9 page personalised report delivered within 48 hours, and a 30 minute follow-up call. £495.
- [AI Workflow Insiders Community](https://www.skool.com/ai-workflow-insiders-2123/about): Practical AI community with weekly workflow rebuilds, Monday prompts, and tool walkthroughs. $29 per month.
- [Corporate Training](https://configurai.com/corporate): Custom AI training programmes for finance teams and general corporate teams, delivered across three tiers (Spotlight, Workshop, Sprint).

## About the founder

ConfigurAI is a London AI training and implementation consultancy for finance teams, accountancy firms and small businesses, founded by Orgesa Meli after 17 years in corporate finance and banking. Orgesa runs 3 businesses with AI doing the jobs she would otherwise hire for, and she built configurai.com herself with AI.

## Important notes

- ConfigurAI focuses on 2 AI tools: ChatGPT and Claude. The finance training is built on Claude.
- The half day works on the team's real files.
- In the finance training, the AI drafts and a person posts, pays and sends.
- The AI features inside accounting systems are partly in beta and change monthly.
- ConfigurAI is based in London, United Kingdom.
